verdict.rationale: Calendly documents connecting multiple calendars and checking them for conflicts before someone books time, and a community user confirms it checks multiple calendars. That only prevents double-booking of Calendly meetings. Nothing shows it writes busy blocks from one calendar into another so work and personal calendars stay in step. Missing for 10: automatic busy-block mirroring between work and personal calendars, two-way calendar sync of non-Calendly events, documentation of sync behavior, hands-on corroboration.
